behavior: A toast that closes while it has no mounted root, such as a toast of a provider with no viewport, leaves the list at once, and its `onRemove` runs at once. An add with its id then makes a new toast. In Base UI, such a toast stays in the list in its exit until a root mounts and ends the exit, so its `onRemove` waits, and an add with its id replaces it and drops that `onRemove`.
